# Tabutility

> Tabutility (https://tabutility.com) is a collection of 150 free, no-sign-up online utility tools that run entirely in the browser: salary and take-home pay calculators for the UK, US, Australia, Canada and Japan, mortgage and loan calculators, tax tools, SEO utilities, developer tools, converters and health calculators. No accounts, no data collection — every tool works instantly on the page.

## Key tools
- [UK Salary Calculator](https://uk-salary-calculator.tabutility.com/): UK take-home pay with 2025/26 HMRC rates
- [US Paycheck Calculator](https://us-paycheck-calculator.tabutility.com/): US federal + state take-home pay
- [Australian Tax Calculator](https://australian-tax-calculator.tabutility.com/): ATO 2025-26 take-home pay
- [Canada Income Tax Calculator](https://canada-income-tax.tabutility.com/): all 13 provinces and territories
- [Canada Express Entry CRS Calculator](https://canada-crs-calculator.tabutility.com/): official IRCC points tables
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://mortgage-calculator.tabutility.com/): repayments, interest and amortisation
- [SERP Snippet Preview](https://serp-snippet-preview.tabutility.com/): pixel-accurate Google result preview
- [Schema Markup Generator](https://schema-markup-generator.tabutility.com/): valid JSON-LD structured data

## Salary hubs
- [UK salary pages](https://tabutility.com/uk-salary/): take-home for every salary £20,000–£200,000
- [Canada salary pages](https://tabutility.com/ca-salary/): take-home for C$30,000–C$230,000
- [All tools directory](https://tabutility.com/tools/)

## Blog
- [Data stories and guides](https://tabutility.com/blog/): self-computed analyses of salaries, tax and affordability using official government rates
